item.text: {"analysis":"The candidate ran successfully and achieved validation HR@10 of 0.625, with its best checkpoint at epoch 10 of 30. Validation HR@5 was 0.51 and HR@20 was 0.78. This confirms that shared convolutional blocks support effective learning in this run. Without an unshared baseline result, it does not establish that weight sharing improves generalization or HR@10. The earlier best checkpoint indicates that later training did not improve the selected metric.","code_summary":"A causal NextItNet with 64-dimensional tied item embeddings, positional embeddings, dropout 0.2, and eight residual stages. Four distinct blocks with dilations 1, 2, 4, and 8 are applied twice, halving convolutional parameters relative to eight independent blocks. Each block uses two left-padded causal convolutions, pre-layer normalization, GELU, dropout, and a residual connection. Padding is masked after each block and final normalization; candidate scoring uses the actual last observed position. Hyperparameters: maximum length 128, kernel size 3, learning rate 0.001, weight decay 0, batch size 128. Training and evaluation remain host-owned."}
